newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH SHARES INCH UP IN STABLE TURNOVER.
newsitem.headline: POLISH SHARES INCH UP IN STABLE TURNOVER.

text.p: 1030 GMT - Polish shares inched up after Tuesday's fall but selling was stronger after price fixing. * The main market's WIG index rose 54 points, or 0.3 percent, to 17,220.5, the WIG 20 rose 0.3 percent to 1,709.1 and the parallel market's WIRR rose 1.3 percent to 3,743.3. * Turnover inched up 1.8 percent to 278.1 million zlotys on both markets as 74 issues rose, 24 fell and 15 were flat. * The National Investment Fund NIF index rose 1.4 percent to 141 points in a turnover of 18.6 million zlotys. NFI units fell 1.5 percent to 135.5 zlotys in a turnover of 14.2 million zlotys. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
